sad.definition: When someone feels sad, they have a bad feeling because of a loss or other problem. They are not happy.

safe.definition: If something is safe, it is not in danger.
safe.sentence: I feel safe when I am at home.

safety.definition: When something is safe or secure.
safety.sentence: It is important to learn traffic safety so you do not get hurt while crossing the street.

sail.definition: A sail is a large piece of fabric (cloth) to catch wind, used on a boat or a ship.

sake.definition: If something is for x's sake or for the sake of x, it is to help x or make x happy.
sake.sentence: You are the reason I did it. I did it for your sake.

salary.definition: Your salary is the money you are paid every month for doing your job.
salary.sentence: Your salary will be paid into your bank on the first day of each month.

sale.definition: A sale is the act of selling something.
sale.sentence: Proceeds from the sale of the art went to the local school.

salt.definition: Salt is a strong-tasting white powder used to improve the flavor of food or to preserve it. Salt is made from sodium and chlorine (chemical formula: NaCl).
salt.sentence: I added salt to my food.

same.definition: Two things are the same if the two things have one size, and one shape, and one color, etc.
same.sentence: Sometimes we wear the same shirt.

sample.definition: A sample is a small amount of something to try or test it.
sample.sentence: The nurse took a small blood sample.

sanction.definition: A sanction is an approval by an authority that makes something valid.
sanction.sentence: It had the sanction of the church.

sand.definition: Grains of rock that make beaches and deserts.
sand.sentence: In the summer, Jane goes to the beach, lies on the sand and listens to the waves.

satisfaction.definition: Satisfaction is a feeling when a need or want has been fulfilled or achieved.
satisfaction.sentence: He enjoyed the dish with great satisfaction and wants to order it again the next time he comes to this restaurant.

satisfy.definition: If you satisfy something, you fulfill it or meet its needs.
satisfy.sentence: Will the results of the investigation satisfy you?

save.definition: If you save something, you keep it; you do not give it or toss it away.
save.sentence: Please save that book for me.

say.definition: When you say something, you share it in words.
say.sentence: Let us say that he did not tell the truth.

scale.definition: The scale of something is its size or level.
scale.sentence: It's hard to understand the scale of the change.

scan.definition: An act of looking through something quickly.

scare.definition: If someone or something scares a person, it makes them feel fear.
scare.sentence: I read once that you can scare away a bear if you wave your arms and look big.

scene.definition: A scene is a place where something happened.
scene.sentence: Who could forget the amazing opening scene of Star Wars?

schedule.definition: A schedule is a plan of things that are happening and the times when they happen.
schedule.sentence: He visits each village in his or her area on a weekly schedule.

scheme.definition: A scheme is a plan, sometimes a bad or dishonest one.
scheme.sentence: The new training scheme will be targeted at recent graduates.

scholar.definition: A scholar is a student who studies at school or college.
scholar.sentence: Socrates was an ancient Greek scholar.

school.definition: A school is a place where you go to learn.
school.sentence: What grade are you in at school?

science.definition: The study of finding how things work. Some kinds of science are mathematics, biology, physics and chemistry.
science.sentence: Biology is a kind of science.

scientific.definition: Of, or having to do with science.

scientist.definition: A scientist is a person who studies science.
scientist.sentence: The scientist looked at the Petri dish under a microscope.

scope.definition: The scope of a book, a law, a duty, etc. is how much is included or how far it can go.
scope.sentence: The small budget has limited the scope of the research.

score.definition: The numbers used to tell who is winning in a sport or game.
score.sentence: I have the whole score for the Brandenburg Concertos.

scream.definition: If you scream, you yell or shout loudly.
scream.sentence: I can hear you. You don't need to scream.

screen.definition: A screen is a flat surface for showing pictures, text or video.
screen.sentence: The information appears on the computer screen almost right away.

sea.definition: A place with a large amount of salt water.

seal.definition: A mammal that lives in watch.
seal.sentence: Place this seal on your website and it will be trusted by your visitors.

search.definition: When someone searches for something, they don't know where it is and they look in many places to try to discover where it is.

season.definition: A season is a particular time of year with a particular kind of weather, usually spring, summer, fall, and winter, or rainy season and dry season.
season.sentence: The theatrical season lasts from early autumn to late spring.

seat.definition: A seat is something to sit on.
seat.sentence: Pull up a seat and sit down.

second.definition: The second thing is the one that is number two (2) in order.
second.sentence: I only have one older brothers and one younger brother. I'm the second child.

secondary.definition: Second, next in order to the first or primary.
secondary.sentence: After finishing elementary school, he went to secondary school.

secondly.definition: If you are somewhere secondly, you are in the second place.
secondly.sentence: He arrived at the office secondly, after the manager.

secretary.definition: A secretary is a person who works in an office, helping with typing letters, filing, and other simple tasks.
secretary.sentence: I will ask my secretary to write to them.

section.definition: A section of a thing or place is a part of it.
section.sentence: The police closed one section of the road because of the accident.

sector.definition: A sector is a part or division of an area, especially part of the economy.
sector.sentence: Service sector jobs, such as restaurant jobs, are often low paying.

secure.definition: When something is secure, it is firmly held in place and probably will not fall.
secure.sentence: Mike's bicycle is very secure on the bike rack.

security.sentence: Traditionally, Japanese workers have had good job security. In fact, they usually had a job for life.

see.definition: You see something when you look at it with your eyes.
see.sentence: I can't see the words in this book because the writing is too small and I don't have my glasses.

seed.definition: A seed is a small round thing that can grow to be a plant, a flower or a tree.

seek.definition: If you seek something, you want it and search for it.
seek.sentence: If you are not sure if this is right for your child, then seek advice from your doctor, a child psychologist or health visitor, or from other parents.

seem.definition: The way something seems to be is the way you think it is when you look at it, hear about it, think about it, etc.
seem.sentence: As odd as it may seem, the girl's best friend is an eighty year old man.

segment.sentence: How long is that segment of rope?

select.definition: If you select something, you choose it.
select.sentence: Students follow a general course in their first year, and in the final year they select one of three specialist areas of study.

selection.definition: A person makes a selection when a person chooses a smaller number of things from a larger group of things.
selection.sentence: The window of the store shows a selection of the things you can buy in the store.

self.definition: Your self is the type of person you are, particularly the way you usually act, look or feel.
self.sentence: He looked so happy compared to his usual down self that Walter wondered if something was wrong.

sell.definition: When you sell something to someone, you give something to someone and the person will give you money for it.
sell.sentence: I sell good shoes for a small amount money.

send.sentence: She needed to send a letter to her mother to say she had arrived safely.

senior.definition: A senior person has a higher social position.
senior.sentence: She's a senior vice-president with the company.

sense.definition: Sense is any basic ability or understanding.
sense.sentence: She has a great sense of fashion.

sensitive.definition: If you are sensitive, you easily understand other people's feelings.
sensitive.sentence: An area on my arm is sensitive, so please don't touch me there.

sentence.definition: In law, a sentence is the punishment that a judge gives to a criminal.

separate.definition: Being separate means that a piece of an object is not connected to or attached to the rest of the object.
separate.sentence: This chair was broken into five separate pieces.

sequence.definition: A sequence is a set of things in a specific order.
sequence.sentence: We read through several lines in sequence, but I kept missing my turn.

series.definition: A series of events, meetings, experiments, etc. is several of them that happen one after the other and are related.
series.sentence: Three weeks ago troops and helicopters launched a series of attacks on Kurds in the region.

serious.definition: A problem or situation is serious if it is not funny or comical, but important.
serious.sentence: This is a serious problem. We must do something.

seriously.definition: You use seriously to show that you are not joking.
seriously.sentence: Seriously, I talked to the president this morning.

servant.definition: A servant is someone who works for a person or for a family, doing things like cooking and washing. Often the servant lives in the house where they work. A servant works for the same family all day.
servant.sentence: The state cannot be a servant of the church.

serve.definition: When you serve food or drink, you give it to somebody to eat or drink, especially as a host.
serve.sentence: Shall I serve your drinks first?

server.definition: A server is a type of computer that people can access through the Internet to visit a website.
server.sentence: I recently bought a server to host my online shop.

service.definition: An action or work by one person that can be consumed by another person.
service.sentence: Hair care is a service industry.

session.definition: A session is the period of time of an activity.
session.sentence: There will be a presentation by Michael Hirschorn, followed by a question-and-answer session.

set.definition: If you set something somewhere, you put something into a place.
set.sentence: After changing the batteries, you have to set the clock again.

settle.definition: If you settle a fight, argument, case, etc., you find an answer that stops it.
settle.sentence: After the crash, it took some time for the dust to settle.

settlement.definition: A settlement is a small, new colony; a new place for people to live.
settlement.sentence: They finally reached a settlement with the union.

several.definition: Their several things is a number of their things.
several.sentence: They each went their several ways.

severe.definition: Something that is severe is very bad.
severe.sentence: He has a severe wound from dropping a big knife on his foot.

shade.definition: A shade is a shadow of a tree or another big thing that blocks some of the light and heat of the Sun.
shade.sentence: She rested in the shade of the tree because she felt hot.

shadow.definition: A shadow is the dark area that is made when something blocks light, and that is shaped like the thing blocking the light.
shadow.sentence: I saw your shadow against the wall.

shake.definition: To shake is to move from side to side many times quickly.
shake.sentence: I couldn't shake the car that was following me.

shall.definition: Shall is usually used to make a suggestion about your own actions.
shall.sentence: Shall I get that for you?

shape.definition: The shape of a thing is its external form.
shape.sentence: The cake was made into the shape of a car.

share.definition: When you share something, you let another person use it.
share.sentence: We can both sit down if you share the chair.

shareholder.definition: Shareholder is the person who shares stocks of a company.

sharp.definition: Having a cutting edge; not dull.

she.definition: A she refers to a female.

sheep.definition: A sheep is an animal that people keep on farms and eat for food.
sheep.sentence: My grandfather has a sheep farm and we get all our wool there.

sheet.definition: A sheet is a flat cloth that you cover a bed with.
sheet.sentence: Can I have a sheet of paper?

shelf.definition: A shelf is a flat thing that people can put books or other things on when they are not using them.

shell.definition: A hard object that can be found on beaches.
shell.sentence: The satellite is covered with a smooth shell of ice.

shelter.definition: A shelter is a place which can protect someone from the rain and sun.
shelter.sentence: There is no shelter nearby. I wonder how we can get out of this heavy rain.

shift.sentence: Let's shift our seats so we can see the stage better.

shine.definition: If something shines, light comes from it, or it reflects light.
shine.sentence: I love the way the stars shine.

ship.definition: A ship is a large boat.
ship.sentence: We sailed by ship from England to Italy.

shirt.definition: A shirt is a piece of clothing you wear on the upper part of your body. Shirts are not very thick.
shirt.sentence: I need a new shirt to go with my new pants.

shock.definition: A shock is the way it feels when a heavy thing suddenly hits another thing.

shoe.definition: Two shoes are two things that someone wears on their feet. Shoes have a hard, flat bottom.

shop.sentence: He bought a hat from the shop.

shore.definition: The shore is the land found close to the waters' edge.
shore.sentence: The sailors decided to eat on the shore.

short.definition: If something is short then there is a small distance from the bottom to the top. The opposite is tall.
short.sentence: I can't reach the table because I'm too short.

should.definition: You use should to say that it is a good idea to do something.
should.sentence: If you have a test, you should be studying.

shoulder.definition: The part of the body where an arm attaches or joins.
shoulder.sentence: He stopped the car on the shoulder of the highway to change the flat tire.

shout.definition: If you shout, you speak very loudly.
shout.sentence: Don't shout! I can hear you fine.

show.definition: When you show something, you make it easy for people to see it.
show.sentence: Can you show me your ID?

shower.definition: A shower is a place with water spraying down to clean something.
shower.sentence: I got up, went to the toilet, and jumped in the shower.

shut.definition: Move so that an opening or passage is obstructed; make shut.

sick.definition: If a person, animal, or plant is sick, it has a disease and is not healthy.
sick.sentence: I'm sorry, I'm too sick to go to work today.

side.definition: A side is a straight edge of an object.
side.sentence: This car has only one door on each side.

sigh.definition: When someone sighs, they take a big breath and breathe out in a relaxed way because they feel relieved or disappointed.

sight.definition: Having sight is if you can see things.
sight.sentence: The Statue of Liberty is a popular sight in New York City.

sign.definition: A flat thing with a few words or pictures on it to tell people something.
sign.sentence: I saw a stop sign, so I stopped the car.

signal.definition: A picture, or a light, or a movement of a hand, or other thing that tells people to do something.
signal.sentence: When I make this signal with my hand, everybody walk to the front of the room.

significance.definition: The significance of something is how important or large its effect or influence is.
significance.sentence: The significance of the discovery was not well understood at the time.

significant.definition: If something is significant, it is important, or large, enough to pay attention to or to believe.
significant.sentence: There was a significant drop in the price of gas today, causing drivers to line up at the pumps to fill up.

significantly.definition: In an important or large enough way.
significantly.sentence: The price of gas dropped significantly today, causing drivers to line up at the pumps to fill up.

silence.definition: Silence is when no noise is heard.
silence.sentence: The silence was strange, not even a bird could be heard.

silent.definition: If something is silent, there is no sound. It is unheard.
silent.sentence: The candidates were silent during the exam.

silly.definition: If something is silly, it shows that somebody didn't think about it carefully.
silly.sentence: I was making silly little jokes and she was laughing.

silver.definition: A metal with a near white colour and high value and the symbol Ag.
silver.sentence: He paid with a silver dollar.

similar.definition: If two things are similar, they are almost the same, or the same in many, but not all, ways.
similar.sentence: Canadian English is similar to American English, but there are some small differences in pronunciation, and spelling.

similarly.definition: You use, similarly to show that two ideas are partly the same.
similarly.sentence: Canadians sell more TV programs abroad than almost any other country. Similarly, Canadian songwriters sell more of their music abroad than they do in Canada.

simple.definition: A simple task is easy to do and easy to understand.
simple.sentence: It's a simple book for learners to read and understand.

simply.definition: You use simply to emphasize that something is true and thinking about it in different ways won't change that.
simply.sentence: We aren't buying a new car because we simply can't afford it.

sing.definition: If you sing you use your voice to make music.
sing.sentence: I'm going to sing a song to you.

singer.definition: A singer is someone who sings.
singer.sentence: She is a very good singer.

single.definition: A single thing is the only one.
single.sentence: In large baking dish, arrange chicken pieces in single layer.

sink.definition: If something sinks, it goes down, usually into water.

sir.definition: You use sir to speak or write to a man formally to be polite.
sir.sentence: Excuse me, sir, could you tell me where the nearest bookstore is?

sister.definition: Your sister is the daughter of your mother and father, except yourself.
sister.sentence: The Sister said that I must rest more.

sit.definition: When you sit, your body is not standing, but is in a position so that your bottom is on something.
sit.sentence: I sit on a chair at the table.

site.definition: A site is a location or a place.
site.sentence: He was working on a building site in Alton when a concrete mixer rolled back and hit him.

situate.definition: If something is situated somewhere, it is there.

situation.definition: A situation is the conditions at a time and place.
situation.sentence: Can you describe the situation in Iraq during the war?

size.definition: How big or small a thing is.
size.sentence: A wolf is about the size of a large dog.

ski.definition: A ski is a long piece of wood, metal or other material designed so a person who wears them on his feet can quickly move through snow.

skill.definition: Being able to do something well. Unlike abilities, skills must usually be learned.
skill.sentence: The skill of a well-trained boxer.

skin.definition: The outer layer of an animal or human.

skirt.definition: A skirt is a loose cloth that a woman uses to cover her legs; the lower part of a dress.
skirt.sentence: She has a blue skirt and a red shirt on.

sky.definition: The sky is what you see when you look up when you're not inside. It's blue with clouds in it. At night it's black with stars in it.
sky.sentence: The night sky was full of stars.

slave.definition: A slave is a person who is owned by a master and who works for that master, but receives no—or almost no—money.

sleep.definition: If you sleep, you rest quietly with eyes shut, usually in bed for many hours at night.
sleep.sentence: I need to sleep now because I'm tired.

slice.definition: A slice is a piece of something that has been sliced.
slice.sentence: A slice of the company's revenue.

slide.definition: If something slides, it moves smoothly and easily, usually over a surface.
slide.sentence: Carefully slide the egg from the fry pan onto the warm plate.

slight.definition: A slight increase, difference, etc. is a small change.
slight.sentence: Don't worry about me. It's just a slight pain.

slightly.definition: A little; to a very small degree.
slightly.sentence: The two pictures look very similar, but they are slightly different.

slip.definition: When something slides, or moves a small distance while touching what it's on, we say it slips.

slope.definition: A slope is one side of a hill.
slope.sentence: We will have to climb up this slope to get to the top of the hill.

slow.definition: Something is slow if it takes a long time to move. It is not fast.
slow.sentence: A snail is a very slow animal. It moves slowly.

slowly.definition: When something moves slowly or does something slowly, it takes a very long time to do it.
slowly.sentence: She was very tired, and walked slowly up the stairs to bed.

small.definition: A small person or thing is not big. It doesn't have much size.

smart.definition: Someone who is smart shows intelligence.
smart.sentence: You know algebra? Wow, you're smart!

smell.definition: If you smell something, you use the nose to sense it.
smell.sentence: She put her nose near the flowers and breathed in to smell them.

smile.definition: To put one's mouth in a form which shows that one is happy; to have the sides of one's mouth higher than the middle.

smoke.definition: Smoke is the gray or black substance that goes up into the air when something burns.
smoke.sentence: The smoke from that factory is making me sick.

smooth.definition: Smooth feels pleasant and flat when you touch it; not rough.
smooth.sentence: He felt the smooth skin on her cheek.

snow.definition: Snow is precipitation (falling water) that is white and frozen.
snow.sentence: I like to ski on the snow.

so.sentence: The box was so wide that the person was not able to take it through the door.

social.definition: A social is a festive gathering to let people introduce oneself to others.

society.definition: A society is an organization or club that people can join.
society.sentence: They formed a small lunch society.

soft.definition: A soft thing is nice to touch.

software.sentence: This wiki runs the MediaWiki software available from MediaWiki.org.

soil.definition: A mix of sand and other natural material on the surface of the earth that is used to grow plants.
soil.sentence: The refugees were happy to return to their home soil.

solar.definition: If something is solar, it is of or related to the sun.

soldier.definition: A soldier is someone who is part of an army.
soldier.sentence: The soldier was shot in the war.

solid.definition: If something is solid, it is hard and keeps its shape.
solid.sentence: When he went out in the morning, the water had frozen solid.

solution.definition: A solution is an answer to a problem.
solution.sentence: The only solution is new regulations.

solve.definition: If you solve a problem, you fix it or deal with it.

some.definition: Relatively many but unspecified in number.
some.sentence: They were here for some weeks.

somebody.definition: A somebody is a person who is famous or important.

somehow.definition: You use somehow to show that you do not know how something works.
somehow.sentence: I somehow managed not to get wet, even with the rain.

someone.definition: A human being; person, singular, assertive existential pronoun; pronoun, person, singular; quantifier: assertive existential.

something.definition: Something is a quality that is difficult to identify.

sometimes.definition: Things that happen sometimes only happen at certain times, or on certain occasions, but not every time.
sometimes.sentence: The bus sometimes arrives late, especially if it is raining.

somewhat.definition: To a small degree or extent.

somewhere.sentence: They moved to somewhere in Spain.

son.definition: A son is a male child of someone.

song.definition: A song is some music with words in verse.

soon.definition: Something that happens soon happens shortly after another time, often shortly after the time of speaking.
soon.sentence: Why did he call me so soon? Did something bad happen?

sorry.definition: You say "I'm sorry" when you have done something wrong and you feel bad.
sorry.sentence: I'm sorry that I lost your jacket last night.

sort.definition: To sort is to divide one group of things into smaller groups of things, so that the things in one smaller group are the same as each other in some way.

soul.definition: A part of you that cannot be seen or touched. Souls are prominent in some religions and myths.
soul.sentence: He went to church hoping to save his soul.

source.definition: If you source something, then you obtain or receive it.

south.definition: The direction opposite to north. For a person looking at the setting sun, the south is on their left hand.
south.sentence: The wind usually comes from the south.

southern.definition: A southern place, accent, person, etc. is in, from, or about the south.
southern.sentence: The money helps everyone from a grocer in southern Lebanon to a farmer in Tajikistan.

space.definition: Space is area or room with nothing in it or that can be used.
space.sentence: Make a space between the tables so people can walk there.

spare.definition: If you spare (somebody) something, you make it available even though you don't have much of it.
spare.sentence: Excuse, me! Can you spare a few minutes to look at this?

speaker.definition: A speaker is a person that speaks.
speaker.sentence: Bob is a native English speaker.

special.definition: If something is special, it is not usual; it is different or important in some way.
special.sentence: She is the most special person in my life.

specialist.definition: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled in one type of activity or study.
specialist.sentence: It hurt so much when she swallowed food that she was sent to a throat specialist.

specialize.definition: If you specialize in something, you are an expert of a particular subject, skill or field.

species.definition: A species is the most specific level in the scientific tree.
species.sentence: Humans belong to the species Homo sapiens.

specific.definition: If something is specific, it is detailed, clear, and limited.
specific.sentence: Last time, he was happy to do anything, but feels this time he has to be more specific.

specifically.definition: You use specifically to focus attention on the particular or special reason that something is done.
specifically.sentence: The software is designed specifically to address the needs of blind users.

specify.definition: If you specify something, you say exactly which one or how to do something.
specify.sentence: We're supposed to meet here on Tuesday, but we forgot to specify a time.

speech.definition: When we have speech, we have the ability to speak.
speech.sentence: Speech is a special human ability.

speed.definition: When you speed, you move or do something very fast.
speed.sentence: If you speed in your car, you might have an accident.

spell.sentence: C, A and T spell cat.

spend.definition: When you spend money, you give the money to buy something.
spend.sentence: I spend too much at the book store each month.

spin.definition: If you spin something, then you move it around in circles or rotate it.

spirit.definition: A spirit is a being that has no physical body, and cannot usually be seen or touched.
spirit.sentence: The preacher claimed the soul was the mind but the spirit was something more special.

split.definition: If a group of people splits or is split, the people don't agree, so the group becomes more than one group.
split.sentence: East and West Germany were split apart at the end of World War II.

sponsor.definition: If you sponsor an event or you sponsor somebody to do an event, you give them money, usually in exchange for advertising.
sponsor.sentence: Don't expect Senator Schaffer to sponsor legislation around those issues.

sport.definition: Sport is physical exercise which involves players playing in a team.

spot.definition: A spot is a small area that's different from that area around it.
spot.sentence: I have a bald spot on my head.

spread.definition: If you spread something, you make it cover a larger area.
spread.sentence: The spilled water spread over the table.

spring.definition: A spring is a twisted metal thing that can stretch and push.
spring.sentence: The emerging buds were a sure sign of spring.

square.definition: A square (￭) is a form with 4 equal sides and 4 equal angles.
square.sentence: You can compute the area of a square if you know the length of its sides.

stability.definition: Stability is the property of being firm and constant.
stability.sentence: Investors, especially foreign ones, want political stability to go with economic growth.

stable.definition: If something is stable, it is unlikely to move or change.
stable.sentence: That number has remained relatively stable over the years.

staff.sentence: The hospital has an excellent nursing staff.

stage.definition: A high floor where some people perform while other people watch.
stage.sentence: The actors performed on the stage while the audience watched.

stain.definition: A stain is an ugly mark on a surface.

stair.definition: A stair is one flight of steps.

stake.definition: A stick or rod with a sharp point. A stake is usually hammered into the ground. Often, the stake is tied to rope to connect something (like a tent) to the ground.
stake.sentence: I had a personal stake in hunger relief, since family had no food.

stamp.definition: A little coloured square of paper that someone sticks to a letter when they want to send the letter.
stamp.sentence: The stamp goes in the upper right part of the outside of the letter.

stand.definition: When you stand, your body is at rest and supported only by your feet.
stand.sentence: I stand in the bus when there are no seats.

standard.definition: If something is standard, it is typical or usual.
standard.sentence: The store sells standard American food.

star.definition: A star is a bright thing in the sky at night. The sun is also one of stars.
star.sentence: My teacher put a gold star on my test.

stare.definition: When someone is looking at you for a very long time, he is staring at you.

start.definition: The beginning of something in place or time.
start.sentence: We went back to the start.

state.definition: A state is a condition or a situation.
state.sentence: I am worried about her. She is in a constant state of depression.

statement.definition: A statement is a claim someone makes that is true or false.
statement.sentence: I don't agree with that statement.

station.definition: A station is a place where many trains or buses stop and people buy tickets and get on.
station.sentence: He started looking for a gas station.

statistic.sentence: That statistic about the number of unemployment this month must be wrong.

status.definition: Your status is your level, role, or situation in a group or society.
status.sentence: With the change in employment status came changes in responsibilities and pay.

stay.definition: When you stay somewhere, you do not move from there.
stay.sentence: Whenever I am tired I stay in bed.

steal.definition: If you steal, you take somebody's money or things without their permission.

steel.definition: A very strong metal made of iron and other substances mixed together.
steel.sentence: All my pots for cooking are made of steel.

stem.definition: A stem is a long, thin thing joining parts of a plant.
stem.sentence: Thematic vowels are part of the stem.

step.definition: When you step, you move one foot.
step.sentence: When you walk, you step many times.

still.sentence: No one has fixed the oven -- It is still broken.

stimulate.definition: If you stimulate someone or something, you encourage them into action.

stir.definition: If you stir something, you move it in a circular movement.
stir.sentence: He needed to stir the water into the flour.

stock.definition: Your stock is the collection of things that you have available, usually to sell.
stock.sentence: It depend on where the store got its stock from.

stomach.definition: The place in the body where food is digested.
stomach.sentence: He had no stomach for a fight.

stone.definition: A stone is a hard, solid piece of earth.
stone.sentence: I do not have a hammer but I will use a stone to hammer the nail.

stop.definition: If you stop, you do not move; you rest.
stop.sentence: The police tried to stop the criminal, but he was too fast.

storage.definition: Storage is the space for storing goods.
storage.sentence: There is a lot of storage space in those cabinets.

store.definition: A store is a building with many things in it, where people can exchange money for things.
store.sentence: He went to the store to get some milk.

storm.definition: A storm is bad weather with high winds that disturbs the atmosphere.
storm.sentence: Small boats should stay off the water tonight because we are expecting a storm.

story.definition: A story is a piece of text that tells someone who reads it about a real or fictional (made up) event.
story.sentence: This story is about a little girl who is eaten by a wolf.

straight.definition: If something goes straight, it continues to move in one direction without turning.
straight.sentence: No not that road. Just keep driving straight.

strain.sentence: His responsibilities were a constant strain.

strange.sentence: My brother is so strange that he can turn his eyelids inside out.

stranger.definition: A stranger is a person you don't know.

strategy.definition: A strategy is a planned way to do something.
strategy.sentence: You can't just do whatever comes into your head. You need to have a strategy.

stream.definition: A stream is a very small river or creek.
stream.sentence: Stop interrupting me, you are breaking my stream of thought.

street.definition: A road in a city with buildings on the sides and places where people can walk.
street.sentence: I saw a woman with a dog walking down the street.

strength.definition: If you have strength your muscles are very powerful.
strength.sentence: I don't have the strength to lift something that heavy.

strengthen.definition: If something is strengthened, then it is made stronger; strength is added to it.
strengthen.sentence: They are keen to strengthen ties with the UN.

stress.definition: Stress is emotional pressure that makes you worry because things are not going well.
stress.sentence: Plants under stress from lack of water or disease are the most likely to attract problem insects.

stretch.definition: To pull; to move one end of something as far as possible from the other end.
stretch.sentence: He was big and the shirt was little, but he was able to stretch it and use it.

strict.sentence: The father was very strict about the children coming to dinner on time.

strike.definition: When you hit something, you strike it.
strike.sentence: If you strike a person, it will hurt.

string.definition: A string is a long, thin and flexible cord that is used for tying.
string.sentence: My dog tried to grab one sausage with his mouth, but he took the whole string of sausages.

strip.definition: A strip is a narrow, long piece of something.
strip.sentence: He felt a flat strip of muscle.

stroke.definition: A stroke is when blood stops coming into your brain.
stroke.sentence: I had a stroke after running so hard.

strongly.definition: In a strong or powerful way.
strongly.sentence: John strongly opposes that law. He refuses to change his opinion.

structural.definition: Structural changes, problems, damage, etc. are related to the structure of something.
structural.sentence: Repainting the house is easy, but the structural damage will be harder to fix.

structure.definition: The structure of something is the way that it is put together.
structure.sentence: The structure of her writing makes it very easy to understand.

struggle.definition: If you struggle to do something difficult, you work very hard to do it.

student.definition: A student is person who studies a subject, especially in a school.
student.sentence: I am a student at the school.

studio.definition: A studio is a place where an artist makes art.

study.definition: A study is a formal effort to learn about something, usually with a written report at the end.
study.sentence: A recent study of New Mexico, completed using national survey data, indicates that many older New Mexicans are returning to school.

stuff.definition: Stuff is what makes up something; the things that it is made from.
stuff.sentence: What is all that stuff on your bedroom floor?

stupid.definition: If something or someone is stupid, it shows a lack of clear thought.

style.definition: A style is a specific look, design, or way of dressing or acting.
style.sentence: We have a new manager, but her style is much more friendly than the old guy.

subject.definition: A subject is a branch of knowledge in school, college or university, such as English, math, science, and history.
subject.sentence: The subject of the class is English literature.

submit.definition: If you submit something, usually a piece of writing, you give it to somebody to be checked or accepted.
submit.sentence: Although most people submit willingly to this process, very few of them have any choice in the matter.

subsequent.sentence: When he came the first time, he was very quiet, but on subsequent visits, he was much more talkative.

subsequently.definition: If something happens subsequently, it happens after something else in time.
subsequently.sentence: He studied law and subsequently became a judge.

substance.definition: What a thing is made of; the essential or most important part of anything. Everything is made of substances.
substance.sentence: DNA is the substance of our genes.

substantial.definition: If something is substantial, it is not small.
substantial.sentence: The children spent a substantial portion of the day in free play or unstructured time.

substitute.definition: A substitute is a person on standby for a sport team or school teacher.
substitute.sentence: Although he was only a substitute for the team, but he played very well during yesterday's match.

succeed.definition: If something succeeds, it has happened the way somebody wants it to happen.
succeed.sentence: It's more difficult for women to succeed in business.

success.definition: Success is doing what you plan or want to do.
success.sentence: Let's call heads a success and tails a failure.

successful.definition: If you are successful, you are effective at something.
successful.sentence: The successful business man knows how to get money for his work.

successfully.definition: In a successful way; with success; without failing.

such.definition: Such a person or thing is that same kind that was mentioned before.
such.sentence: We always had pets, such as cats, dogs, and birds.

sudden.definition: Very quick; taking no time or almost no time, and being a surprise.
sudden.sentence: Not expecting the sudden change in the weather, he got rained on.

suddenly.definition: If something happens suddenly, it happens very quickly when you don't expect it to happen.
suddenly.sentence: My son had been sitting in the chair beside me. Then, suddenly, I realised he was gone.

suffer.definition: When you suffer, you have pain or sadness, or otherwise feel very bad.
suffer.sentence: The wound caused him to suffer greatly.

sufficient.definition: If something is sufficient, it means there is enough or that it is good enough.
sufficient.sentence: We now have a sufficient number of people to do the job.

sugar.definition: Sugar is a small white powder. It looks like salt, but it tastes sweet. Some people put it in tea.
sugar.sentence: This cookie recipe says you should use two cups of sugar, but I think that will be too sweet. One cup is enough.

suggest.definition: If a person says an option, he or she is suggesting.
suggest.sentence: I suggest that we go to the mall.

suggestion.definition: An idea for something to do, that someone says to another person. The other person is free to do the thing or not do the thing.

suit.definition: A suit is a set of clothes that includes a coat or and pants or dress.
suit.sentence: Everyone wears a suit where I work.

suitable.definition: Something suitable is right for a particular purpose.
suitable.sentence: He had to find a suitable pair of shoes for running.

sum.definition: A sum is an amount of money, usually a large amount.

summarize.definition: If you summarize something, you prepare a brief list of the main points discussed.

summary.definition: A summary is a short explanation of a longer idea, article, story, etc.
summary.sentence: In this short time, I can provide only a summary of the work we have done.

summer.definition: The part of the year when the weather is hot.
summer.sentence: There is no school in the summer.

sun.definition: A star, especially a star that is at the center of a solar system.
sun.sentence: The shingles were weathered by the sun and wind.

supplement.definition: A supplement is extra text that is added to the end of a book.
supplement.sentence: At the back of the book was a supplement with maps showing where the story took place.

supplier.definition: A supplier is someone who supplies something. Most often, this is a company that supplies another company with things it needs.
supplier.sentence: The car factory needs a new supplier for car parts.

supply.definition: A supply is an amount of something that you can use when you need it.
supply.sentence: We will need a supply of water.

support.definition: To keep something up; to be a base for something.
support.sentence: She has money, so she can support her children.

supporter.definition: A supporter is someone that supports a cause or a movement, usually because the person believes in it.

suppose.definition: When you suppose something, you guess that it is true.
suppose.sentence: What do you suppose that he will do?

sure.definition: When you are sure about something, you are certain.
sure.sentence: The student was sure that his answer was correct.

surely.definition: You use surely to suggest that you strongly hope or believe that what you say is correct.
surely.sentence: Surely, she won't be late this time.

surface.definition: The surface of an object is the outside of the thing.
surface.sentence: The surface of the earth is very large.

surgery.definition: Surgery is a way of removing, repairing or replacing a part of a body that involves incisions.
surgery.sentence: After the doctor performed surgery, John was able to walk again.

surprise.definition: To do something that another person didn't think you were going to do.

surprisingly.definition: In a very surprising way or to a very surprising level.

surround.definition: When you surround something, you confine that object on all sides of it.

survey.definition: A survey is a broad look at a topic or place.
survey.sentence: Before looking for a job, he did a survey of the companies in the area.

survival.definition: Survival is the state of continuing to live.
survival.sentence: Survival is a success for any species.

survive.definition: If you survive something, you experience it and you did not die.
survive.sentence: These last few months have been hard, but we'll survive.

suspect.definition: If you suspect something, you feel that something, often bad, is probably true.
suspect.sentence: I suspect you've already erased the file, have you?

suspend.definition: If you suspend something, you stop it for a time.

sustain.definition: If something is sustained, it is maintained.
sustain.sentence: I tried to sustain the energy level of the party by playing some rock music.

swear.definition: When you swear, you say a swear word.
swear.sentence: Before God I swear I am innocent.

sweep.definition: When you sweep the floor, you use the broom to clean it.
sweep.sentence: Sweep the crumbs off the table.

sweet.definition: If something is sweet, it tastes like sugar or fruit.
sweet.sentence: This cake is very sweet. I think you put much sugar in it.

swim.definition: If you swim, you move through the water using your arms and legs.
swim.sentence: I don't like boats because I can't swim.

swing.definition: A swing is a hanging seat found in a playground that children can sit on and swing on.
swing.sentence: The child was swinging on the swing at the playground.

switch.definition: If you switch something, you change it to something else.
switch.sentence: Jump ten times, switch legs and repeat.

symbol.definition: A symbol is a letter or simple picture with a particular meaning.
symbol.sentence: After a long, cold winter flowers are a symbol of hope for the new season.

symptom.definition: A symptom is a sign or indication of something, usually an illness.

system.definition: A system is a group of things that work together; a way of doing something.
system.sentence: This coloured paper is part of my system for keeping lists of people.
